# Newsshooter

> > Newsshooter is a leading publication covering DSLR video production, cinema cameras, and professional filmmaking gear with extensive NAB trade show coverage.

Founded by Dan Chung, Newsshooter provides in-depth reviews, interviews, and trade show coverage focused on the intersection of photography and video production. The site features extensive coverage of Canon cinema cameras (EOS-1D C, C300, C500), DSLR video workflows, and professional accessories from manufacturers like Zacuto, Jag35, and Teradek.

## Key Topics

- DSLR Video Production
- Canon Cinema Cameras (EOS-1D C, C300, C500)
- NAB Trade Show Coverage
- Camera Accessories & Rigging
- Zacuto DSLR Accessories
- Professional Cinematography
- Run-and-Gun Filming
- Electronic Viewfinders (EVF)
- HDMI to SDI Conversion
- Wireless Video Transmission
- Color Grading & Post-Production
- Camera Movement & Stabilization
- Lens Adapters & Smart Adapters
- Underwater Camera Housing
